verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is audit logs that track changes to workspaces, messages, and other assets, plus MCP permissions that separate reads from writes and deletes so each category can be approved independently; together these give limited change tracking and review of AI-driven edits. Nothing in the pack shows automation versioning or rollback. Missing for 10: automation version history, diff or review workflow for automation changes, rollback/restore of prior automation versions, version control via CLI/API, and independent corroboration.
